Better control over ID photos.

### What's changed
- **See the whole photo.** When adding or editing a person, **Zoom** now goes out as well as in: zoomed right out, the whole photo shows in its frame and nothing is cut off. **Whole photo** does it in one step, and you can drag the photo anywhere in the frame.
- **Choose how templates fit photos.** In the template builder, select the photo and choose **Fill the frame** (photos of another shape are trimmed at the edges, as before) or **Whole photo** (nothing is cut off; any space shows the frame's colour). Imported photos follow the template, and each person can still be adjusted.

Existing templates keep filling the frame, so cards print as before until you change it.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.9 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.9.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
